ORDINANCE LVII OF 2000
CORPORATE AND
INDUSTRIAL RESTRUCTURING CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE
LVII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Corporate and Industrial Restructuring Corporation Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th November, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 17‑11‑2000.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the President
is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Corporate
and Industrial Restructuring Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

sections.shortTitle: Corporate and Industrial Restructuring Corporation Amendment Ordianace 2000
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Ordinance L of 2000

ORDINANCE LVII OF 2000
CORPORATE AND
INDUSTRIAL RESTRUCTURING CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE
LVII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Corporate and Industrial Restructuring Corporation Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th November, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 17‑11‑2000.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance L of 2000.‑‑In the Corporate and Industrial
Restructuring Corporation Ordinance, 2000 (L of 2000), in section 2, in clause
(n), for sub‑clause (c), the following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"(c) with respect to which
the obligor's outstanding payment obligation to any financial institution
exceeds thirty million rupees:
Provided that the Federal
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, alter, reduce or
increase the said amount as and when it deems fit."
